headline: Argentina approves $50 billion LNG export project
summary: The Argentine government approved a $50 billion liquefied natural gas (LNG) export project led by state energy firm YPF. The project aims to export 12 million tonnes of LNG annually using shale gas from the Vaca Muerta formation.
why: Vaca Muerta is one of the world's largest shale reserves. Developing LNG export capacity is critical for Argentina to monetize its natural resources and improve its balance of payments.

impacts.why: The approval of a major long-term project enhances the company's growth prospects.
